text: Three policies share synthetic plants and inputs. This is task coordination, not a humanoid physics simulation.
Here all completion receipts are lost. New identities turn retries into extra watering. Stable identities stop duplicate pours.
But receipts alone leave the second controller waiting. The queue aware controller uses fresh delivery observations and finishes the three plants.
Now the sensor stream fails instead. Reliable receipts let the first two controllers finish. The queue aware controller refuses to advance on old observations.
The hold leaves two plants unfinished, while the other policies finish without extra water. This is the cost of requiring fresh observations.
